changes.title: AWS Partner Central expands analytics access with Partner Central Agents and Data Subscriptions
changes.detail: AWS Partners and AWS Marketplace sellers now have two new ways to access their analytics data in AWS Partner Central. Partner Central Agents answer questions in plain language, and Data Subscriptions deliver Partner Central data to an Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket every day. Partner Central Agents answer questions about leads, marketing campaigns, opportunities and pipeline, and funding, without navigating dashboards or exporting to spreadsheets. changes.title: AgentCore runtime instances are now generally available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region
changes.detail: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime instances are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region. Runtime instances run your agents on Amazon EC2 instances in your own account, while AgentCore handles provisioning, patching, scaling, and lifecycle management. With runtime instances, teams in AWS GovCloud (US) can choose GPU-accelerated, memory-optimized, or compute-optimized instance types for their agents and run agent sessions of up to 14 days. changes.title: Amazon SageMaker Studio now supports training job submission and model deployment for SageMaker HyperPod clusters
changes.detail: Amazon SageMaker Studio now provides a native developer experience for Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, enabling data scientists to submit distributed training jobs, deploy models, and monitor workloads through a visual interface on HyperPod clusters orchestrated with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). SageMaker HyperPod is a purpose-built infrastructure for distributed training and fine-tuning of foundation models at scale, designed to reduce infrastructure management overhead.
